name: driver-pty
description: A coding agent (claude, codex, pi, any program) in a real terminal inside the running app: the panel gets a terminal tab, the agent builds through the door in its own interactive mode. Development only; needs the agent panel; opt-in with acrylblends add driver-pty.
mount: register it in src/app.ts ('driver-pty': driverPty) and add a row `- id: driver-pty` / `name: driver-pty` to blend.yaml AFTER the agent-panel row; open the panel and pick a `pty:` agent to get its terminal
